about_the_game:
【About This Game】 

The year is 2024, in an alternate timeline. Following a massive accident at a research facility for the new energy source "Atla" that left her parents missing, the protagonist "El" has been living as a shut-in. One day,

her only lifeline—her bank account balance—suddenly drops to ZERO!

With no money for tomorrow's living expenses, a mysterious side-job app called "Byte de Baito" suddenly appears on her PC display.

Guided by Puruya, a strange robot pet left behind by her parents, El's consciousness dives directly into the cyber world. To earn the time needed to keep her physical body alive and survive harsh reality, she begins a life-threatening part-time job, physically "mining" cryptocurrency called "Totcoin" by defeating enemies!

【Key Features】 

■ A "Moving Tower Defense" Where Positioning is Everything! 

This isn't a game about twitch reflexes and dodge-rolls. The approaching autonomous programs, "Labyris," lack ranged attacks. Instead, they form deadly formations with heavily armored shield-bearers and healers to corner you.

Faced with overwhelming numbers, what "build" will you choose, and how will you move? You must use tactical positioning to herd the enemy swarms and wipe them out in one fell swoop.

■ Use "Light" and "Gimmicks" to Turn the Tide 

The darkness of cyberspace is extremely dangerous.

Enemies possess a deadly trait: they are 3 times stronger in the dark. 

You cannot place your own light sources. Instead, you must lure enemies into illuminated areas and utilize stage gimmicks, testing your spatial puzzle-solving skills to secure safe zones.

■ A "Cosplay" Avatar System Born from the Subconscious! 

El is a shut-in gamer with a secret desire to cosplay. In cyberspace, she fights using various "avatars" that reflect her subconscious and deepest wishes.

Starting with "Hakase" (Professor), born from her admiration for her missing parents, you'll unlock unique characters like the literal earth-digging "Digger" and her hobby-driven "Mahjong Player."

Use your mined cryptocurrency to buy new avatar data at the shop, change into the "ideal you," and challenge the deeper layers!

■ Upgrade Your "PC" With Mined Coins! A Realistic Progression System 

Defeating enemies (Labyris) means deciphering the block generation puzzles required for crypto-mining.

Use your hard-earned Totcoins to buy and overclock real-world PC parts (CPU, GPU) or unlock new avatars.

The meta-progression is packed with content! Rise from a weak starting setup and short dive limits, build the ultimate gaming rig, and dive deeper and longer into cyberspace.

■ A Deep Truth Hidden Beneath a Pop World 

What started as a reluctant job just to pay the bills gradually reveals clues about her missing parents as she dives deeper into the mining layers.

Together with the whimsical navigator "Puruya," who only recently learned how to speak human languages, uncover the truth of the world hidden at the very bottom of the deep layers.

Upgrade Weapon Slot and upgrade Mod Item !

Customize your PC !

Earn Gems at mining points!

Upgrade Light to expand your range of action!

Multiple selectable characters.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows10
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 or similar
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 1050 or similar
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: "From zero balance to the ultimate PC build! Join a shut-in gamer girl on a literal crypto-mining dive into cyberspace! A new kind of Vampire Survivors-like roguelite blending intense crowd-control with the strategic positioning of a 'moving tower defense'!"
